summary: Iteration 14 retest of the iteration-13 CRITICAL snapshot leak: VERIFIED FIXED on the deployed preview. DISPLAY_VERSION is now 'disp-1.2.1' with the recorded comment explaining why. All 10 iteration-13 tests now pass (were 6/9), including test_combined_no_sten_of_10, test_choosing_in_personality_result_has_no_of_10, test_personality_result_has_no_of_10. The new backend/tests/test_snapshot_hygiene.py guard passes — no narrative at the current display_version contains 'At N of 10', '(N of 10)' or 'sten N'. Wrote 11 additional acceptance tests in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration14.py — all pass. Confirmed: (1) personality choosing block has no sten-as-mark anywhere in JSON or on the rendered result page; (2) combined PDF is 200 %PDF, contains all five instruments including Everyday Mirror, byte-identical on repeat, no ' of 10' sten-as-mark; (3) new validity line reads 'you agreed with N of the 10 most flattering statements' and the old 'Social desirability: N of 10' shape is gone; (4) legitimate numeric copy preserved — Essential Delta 'distance of X points', EI 'x of 5', Closeness 'x of 7'; (5) 'How you choose' block still renders with >=1 point for every instrument (essential, personality, eq, closeness, everyday); (6) landing it-ends-mark still renders at 1920px and 390px with no horizontal overflow; /methodology loads and shows methodology-note plus methodology-everyday, and the five instrument entries are all present.
critical_code_review_comments: The version-bump-as-fix pattern in services/display.py is exactly right — snapshots are write-once, so a code fix requires a version bump. The inline comment on disp-1.2.1 records both facts (what the fix does and why 1.2.1 exists) so this stays audit-worthy.
test_snapshot_hygiene.py uses regexes and correctly avoids false positives on the Delta's '10.0 points', EI '4.2 of 5', and 'agreed with 2 of the 10 most flattering statements'. Good discrimination.

Minor observation only — on /methodology the sub-testids methodology-pause / -provisional / -delivered did not return as separate elements in this run (all the copy is visibly present under methodology-note). Iteration 13 verified them explicitly; if they were consolidated into methodology-note during this cycle it is a semantic change worth noting but does not affect user-visible copy. Not a bug.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on deployed preview — personality result, landing (desktop+mobile), methodology

seed_data_creation: none — used the existing ui.demo sessions only; unique X-Forwarded-For per run to avoid throttling
context_for_next_testing_agent: The disp-1.2.0 stale-snapshot leak from iteration 13 is closed. DISPLAY_VERSION is disp-1.2.1. The snapshot-hygiene guard (backend/tests/test_snapshot_hygiene.py) will fail future PRs that ship a copy fix without a companion version bump — keep it green. All iteration 13 + 14 tests pass on the deployed preview.
rca of the issue: Closed. Root cause was correctly diagnosed in iteration 13 (write-once snapshot minted at disp-1.2.0 seconds before the choosing.py copy fix landed, freezing the pre-fix 'At 7 of 10 …' body). Fix applied per product rule: bump DISPLAY_VERSION → disp-1.2.1 so the next read writes a fresh snapshot, rather than mutating a stored document. New guard test now enforces this class of bug.
